---
applyTo: "tests/**"
---

Add focused tests for behavior introduced or fixed, including relevant permission, invalid-input, and failure cases. Follow existing PHPUnit/Playwright conventions and use synthetic data. PHP tests require a configured database, an explicit `DB=mysql` or `DB=pgsql`, and `--test-suffix=.php`. Never claim a test passed unless it was run; report skips and environment blockers.
